questions.questionText:
Anand, Hari, and Chris are engaged in one of the three type of occupations –
clerk, teacher, and plumber, not necessarily in that order. Each person is assigned
only one type of occupation. No two or more persons can be assigned same type
of occupation. Clerk is Chris’s cousin. Hari lives next door to the plumber.

reach Hari’s home. Identify each of the person’s correct type of occupation, and
accordingly, which one of the following options is correct?

Hari is clerk and Anand is plumber.
Chris is teacher and Hari is clerk.
Anand is clerk and Chris is plumber.

the United Nation has named India among the worst countries for poor quality of
water. The report ranks 122 countries according to the quality of their water as
well as their commitment to improve the situation. Some countries in Europe are
considered the worst because of the quality of its ground water. Rain failed in
some parts of India in the past. The vast areas of Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and
Andhra Pradesh were affected by severe drought. People without water turn
desperate and violent. Consequently, the food godowns were attacked in some of
the states.

correct statement(s)?
options: There is no proof that India is affected by poor quality of water.
A few European countries are suffering due to occurrence of drought.
Lack of access to water can lead to social unrest.

richOptions.text: There is no proof that India is affected by poor quality of water.
